image.alt: A drawing of Early Harappan painted pots with regional geometric bands, flowers and stylised animals.

beads.alt: A drawing of semi-precious stone beads, long barrel shapes and small round ones.

bangles.alt: A drawing of cut and polished shell bangles beside flat copper axes and a chisel.

graffiti.alt: A drawing of broken pieces of pots with marks scratched into them.

seal.alt: A drawing of an early square stamp seal with carved geometric lines and a simple animal.
